name: com.aexxa.canvascore
description: Performance-focused UI Canvas Manager for uGUI: pooled spawn/despawn, lazy Resources.Load per catalog entry (no eager prefab loading), layered back-stack Screens/Popups, auto-dismiss Toasts, gamepad/keyboard focus that survives popups and recycled lists, a virtualized scroll view (vertical/horizontal, variable sizes, grid), and a built-in localization system players can add languages to after the build.
